name: haumea
description: Haumea monorepo — facilities management SaaS (web + mobile + shared)

scripts.typecheck:packages: npm --workspace=@haumea/types run tsc && npm --workspace=@haumea/utils run tsc && npm --workspace=@haumea/ui run tsc
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:marketing
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:marketing && npm run typecheck:mobile && npm run typecheck:packages
scripts.test:all: npm run test:web -- --run && npm run test:utils
scripts.build:all: npm run build:web && npm run build:marketing
scripts.check:all: npm run lint:all && npm run typecheck:all && npm run test:all && npm run build:all && npm run bundle:audit && npm run check:no-raw-type
